_comment: Coverage context for the dashboard. PolicyEngine rows are transcribed from the local policyengine-coverage-tracker repo; Axiom rows reflect merged axiom-programs specs and the live dashboard comparison suites. Alignment rates are computed from comparison reports at runtime.

programs.name: SNAP
programs.notes: PolicyEngine tracker marks SNAP complete nationally, with remaining special-deduction notes for AK, AZ, HI, NY, TN, and VA.

programs.name: Federal income tax
programs.notes: PolicyEngine tracker marks federal income tax complete and validated against NBER TAXSIM.

programs.name: State income tax
programs.notes: Colorado state income tax is available through PolicyEngine's state income tax liability output.

programs.name: NYC income tax
programs.full_name: New York City personal income tax
programs.notes: PolicyEngine exposes NYC income tax liability through `nyc_income_tax`, including the NYC residence gate, NYC taxable income, rate table, and NYC credit stack.

programs.name: Medicaid / CHIP / BHP thresholds
programs.full_name: Colorado Medicaid, CHIP, and Basic Health Program income thresholds
programs.notes: The current dashboard check validates threshold parameters, not full household-level eligibility.

programs.name: Payroll tax
programs.notes: PolicyEngine tracker marks Social Security and Medicare payroll taxes complete.

programs.name: Universal Credit
programs.notes: Axiom now has an executable Universal Credit award assembly package. The current dashboard comparison remains limited to projection-safe component surfaces over Enhanced FRS until housing, childcare payment, sanctions, capital, and deduction facts can be projected without using PolicyEngine internals as Axiom inputs.

programs.name: TANF
programs.notes: Shown only as context. Current dashboard gap work excludes TANF/TAFDC/Families First modeling.

programs.name: Social Security
programs.notes: PolicyEngine models OASDI parameters; out-year wage-indexed amounts are Trustees/uprating projections until SSA announcements are transcribed.

programs.name: Medicaid eligibility groups
programs.full_name: Federal Medicaid eligibility groups (42 CFR 435), incl. SSI-related and mandatory state supplement groups
programs.notes: PolicyEngine models Medicaid eligibility by category and state income limits; group-by-group 42 CFR 435 pathways are not exposed as separate outputs.

programs.name: SSI
programs.notes: PolicyEngine tracker marks federal SSI complete, with state supplements for several states.
